drafted_from: tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (the workflow:reverse-engineer-how-something-grows row: input_schema and step setup with its submit shape); prices are example numbers, the real run reads them with tool:read-a-treg-endpoint-and-its-price
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:reverse-engineer-how-something-grows on https://example.com in quick mode with a 3 dollar budget; I want to grow my bakery's online pre-orders from 20 to 100 a month."
no_lists_because: The workflow keeps its findings in its own run answers and the person's treg balance, and names no list in its words, input or steps.
instructions: 1. Have a treg connection (service_connection:treg) with some balance; the first step reads it and stops if treg refuses the token.

2. Say "Run workflow:reverse-engineer-how-something-grows" with target (a site address or a name), goal (what you want to grow, in your words), and optionally mode (quick is a first look), budget_usd (default 3) and country (default US).
3. At setup the AI shows you the plan: each step's endpoint and price, the estimated total, your budget and balance. Answer continue, skip or stop before any paid call is made.

4. Each later step ends by telling you its finding in three lines and the cost of the next step; the last steps give plays you can copy, each with the Workshop workflow or tool that runs it and a ready prompt, the plays to skip, and the one to start this week.

worked_examples.title: Setting up a quick look at a bakery site on a 3 dollar budget
worked_examples.ask: Reverse engineer how https://example.com grows, quick mode, 3 dollars.

input.goal: Grow my bakery's online pre-orders from 20 to 100 a month

worked_examples.given: Read from the setup step of the row (tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json). Synthetic values: the person says their domain is mybakery.example, stage early revenue, channels instagram; Search Console connected; tool:read-my-treg-balance answers 12.40 for team 1234; one priced endpoint (treg.web.map, 0.01 dollars per call, example price); the person answers continue.
